text:
Anya: Morning! Quick idea — desk-hydration bingo? Winner gets a sticker and eternal bragging rights. :trophy:
Sam: I'm in. what's on the card? :droplet::cup_with_straw:
Anya: top row = drank water in last hour, brought a reusable bottle, left a glass overnight. middle = iced drink, herb tea, spilled water. bottom = bought fancy bottle, convinced a coworker to hydrate, refilled at fountain.
Jess: I have at least 2 squares already (herb tea + reusable). this is peak Tuesday energy.
Leo: count me out unless 'sipped coffee and called it hydration' is a square. :grimacing:
Marta: Can we add a wild card: "refilled someone else's bottle"? I did that yesterday and felt heroic. :cape:
Anya: yes wild card it is. also small poll: react with :white_check_mark: if you're participating, :x: if not.
Sam: :white_check_mark:
Leo: :white_check_mark: (but it's mostly coffee)
HydrationBot: BINGO ALERT — Leo completed top row at 3123456795. Prize: one mythical sticker. :confetti_ball:
Leo: wait what, when did I become hydrated legend?
Jess: congrats leo. claim your sticker at snack shelf 2.
Marta: also quick one-liner drop: "Hydration is just showering your insides." you're welcome.
Sam: my one-liner: "Drink water like it's your job—because your cells are unionizing."
Anya: gratitude shoutout to Marta for rescuing my lid from the fridge yesterday. lifesaver. :pray:
Jess: tiny office logistics — can someone label the left of the fridge 'science experiments'? found a jar. :eyes:
Marta: i labeled it "prehistoric smoothie".
Anya: ok team, hydration bingo leaderboard on the whiteboard by the coffee station. 1 sticker to the victor. Keep it silly and kind. :sparkles:
